messages:
Maria (docs): Heads-up: opened a small PR to add a tiny migration note and a few SDK snippet fixes for the Optimize toolkit docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3456
Ben (eng-opt): Thanks — pinging to review. Which snippets changed?
Maria (docs): Mostly the quant profiles example and the Python SDK batching snippet. Also fixed two dead links under /optimize/heuristics.
Laura (devex): Can you paste the new SDK snippet here so I can sanity-check the code style?
Maria (docs): Sure — here's the new Python example (keeps it minimal):
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
profile = {"quant": "q4_0", "batching": {"max_batch": 8, "latency_target_ms": 120}}
resp = client.optimize.run_model("redwood/fast-llama", input="Summarize this...", profile=profile)
print(resp.output)
```
Axel (runtime): Small note: `latency_target_ms` is not currently handled by the Python SDK; it's a server-side hint only. We should avoid implying the client enforces it.
Maria (docs): Good call — I'll reword the text to say "server-side hint". Also changed the quant profile table to mention fallback rules for older GPUs.
Ben (eng-opt): Any breaking behavior change users should watch for when moving from q4_1 -> q4_0? We had a subtle tokenization edge case reported last quarter.
Maria (docs): I added a short migration checklist with two items: run evaluation prompts, and test with KV-cache heavy prompts. Short snippet included for rerun: `./scripts/eval_opt_profiles --profile q4_0 --samples 500`.
Laura (devex): Docs-bot shows a linkcheck failure for one of the internal benchmark links in the PR preview. Can you point to the preview build?
docs-bot: Preview site: https://deploy-preview-3456--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration (status: linkcheck failed: /benchmarks/kv-cache-compare)
Maria (docs): I pushed a quick fix to the link target to point to /benchmarks/kv-cache-latency instead. Please re-run the linkcheck CI.
Ben (eng-opt): I'll queue the linkcheck rerun. Also assigning Axel for the technical accuracy check on quant wording.
Axel (runtime): I reviewed the quant wording and left one inline suggestion: clarify that q4_0 has lower memory but slightly lower output fidelity on long-contexts; also add the fallback matrix row: `q4_0 -> q4_1 (fallback, higher mem)`
Maria (docs): Nice. Adding the fallback matrix and rewording the SDK note.
Laura (devex): After edits, can someone run a quick smoke test of the Python snippet and paste the output here? I want to ensure sample output doesn't contain PII or stack traces.
Ben (eng-opt): Ran it locally against staging model (fast-llama-staging). Output is a short summary string, no traces. Example: "Summary: ..."
Maria (docs): Great. I updated PR description with the smoke test note and marked it ready for review.
Laura (devex): I'll do a quick style pass after CI is green. If nothing else, we can merge by EOD. :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-opt): LGTM from product perspective once CI passes.
Axel (runtime): Technical LGTM pending one tiny wording tweak.
Maria (docs): Thanks all — merging after linkcheck passes. Will follow up if any backports needed for older versions. :shipit:
